theme_cn: 语法（介词）+ 听力（地铁）+ KET/PET + 写作模板 + 键盘拼写
writing_name: 背诵作文 · 写给朋友的邮件

grammar.question: 用 in / on / at 填空：We will meet ___ the gate of the puppet theatre at five o'clock.
grammar.explanation_cn: 表示在某个具体的小地点（门口、车站）用 at；at the gate 在大门口。

grammar.question: 用 in / on / at 填空：The show starts ___ seven in the evening.
grammar.explanation_cn: 具体钟点前用 at，at seven 在七点；in the evening 是固定搭配。

grammar.question: 用 in / on / at 填空：My birthday is ___ May, so I am a spring child.
grammar.explanation_cn: 月份前用 in，in May 在五月；具体某一天才用 on。

grammar.question: 用 in / on / at 填空：There is a big map of the city ___ the wall of the station.
grammar.explanation_cn: 贴在表面上用 on，on the wall 在墙上。

grammar.question: We arrived ___ Hangzhou ___ Sunday morning.
grammar.explanation_cn: 大地方（城市）用 arrive in；具体到某一天的上午用 on，所以是 in Hangzhou on Sunday morning。

grammar.question: The cat is sleeping ___ the box under the table.
grammar.explanation_cn: 在盒子里面有空间，用 in the box；on 是「在……上面」。

grammar.question: I get up ___ six o'clock ___ the morning.
grammar.explanation_cn: 钟点用 at，早上/下午/晚上这一整段时间用 in，at six o'clock in the morning。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. Which line goes to the city museum?
listening.audio_text: Woman: Excuse me, which line goes to the city museum? Man: Line Two, and the museum is the third stop. Woman: Thank you very much.
listening.explanation_cn: 男士说 Line Two（二号线），the third stop 是「第三站」，不是三号线。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. How will the girl go to school today?
listening.audio_text: Dad: The road is busy this morning, so we will take the subway. Girl: Good idea, it is faster than the bus. Dad: We need to change at the next station.
listening.explanation_cn: 爸爸说 we will take the subway（我们坐地铁），因为地铁比公交车快。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: Many people are waiting for the train on the platform.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说 waiting for the train on the platform（在站台等地铁），所以选 🚇。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: Please stand behind the yellow ___.
listening.audio_text: Please stand behind the yellow line and let the people get off first.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到 stand behind the yellow line（站在黄线后面），所以填 line。

ket_pet.question: KET: The subway is ___ than the bus in this city.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 有 than 用比较级 faster；fastest 是最高级。

ket_pet.question: KET: ___ does the first train leave? — At five thirty.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 回答是时间 At five thirty，所以问句用 When（什么时候）。

ket_pet.question: KET: You ___ buy a ticket before you get on the train.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 上车前买票是必须做的事，用 must；needn't 是「不必」，mustn't 是「禁止」。

ket_pet.question: PET: If you ___ early, you will get a seat on the train.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: if 引导的条件句「主将从现」：主句用 will，从句用一般现在时 arrive。

ket_pet.question: PET: The museum ___ we visited last week is near the canal.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 先行词 museum 是物，从句 we visited 缺宾语，用关系代词 which；where 要在从句里作地点状语。

writing.title: An e-mail to a friend（给朋友的邮件 · 皮影戏）
writing.requirement_cn: 先把整封邮件大声读三遍，再把 5 个空填好，最后背诵全文。这是本周的背诵任务！
writing.template:
Dear Amy,
Last week I saw a wonderful {{1}} show in the city museum. The little figures are made of {{2}}, and they dance behind a white {{3}}. The old man told a funny {{4}} and sang all the time. Would you like to go with me this {{5}}? Please write back and tell me your idea.
Lin
writing.full_text_cn: 亲爱的Amy：上周我在城市博物馆看了一场很棒的皮影戏。那些小人是用皮革做的，它们在白幕后面跳舞。老人讲了一个好笑的故事，还一直在唱。这个星期六你愿意和我一起去看吗？请回信告诉我你的想法。林
writing.explanation_cn: 背诵重点短语：a puppet show（皮影戏）· be made of（由……做成）· behind a screen（在幕布后面）· tell a story（讲故事）· Would you like to…?（你愿意……吗）。邮件结构：开头说明写信缘由 → 中间描述看到的东西 → 结尾发出邀请并等回复。
writing.explanation_en: A short e-mail about a puppet show: what you saw (a puppet show), what it is made of (leather), where it happens (behind a screen), what the man did (told a story), and a friendly invitation. Note 'be made of' for materials and 'Would you like to...?' for inviting.

spell.question: 票：t_____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: ticket 读 /ˈtɪkɪt/，中间是 ck，结尾是 et。

spell.question: 博物馆：m_____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: museum 三个音节 /mjuːˈziːəm/，中间是 se，重音在第二音节。

spell.question: 星期六：s_______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: Saturday 注意中间的 tur，读 /ˈsætədeɪ/，别漏掉第二个 a。
